title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - Samantha Lee
content:
GOAL: get Type II readiness for Redwood Public Hosted API & Dedicated in-scope (customer data flows)

Quick context / purpose:
- This is my personal scratchpad for tracking open questions, control mapping draft, and evidence backlog for SOC2 prep. Informal notes; will extract to Confluence once more structured.
- Scope decision (tentative): Hosted API (prod), Dedicated (reserved capacity) endpoints, Redwood Console (observability), and auth/identity pieces (SSO/SCIM) included. Private deployments (on-prem) deferred to separate mapping.

Open questions / decisions to confirm:
1) Encryption in transit: we currently enforce TLS 1.2+ for public endpoints. Confirm cipher suite docs for auditors (need server cipher list snapshot).
2) Encryption at rest: Hosted uses provider-managed block volumes + S3. Need KMS key usage logs (AWS CloudTrail -> show GenerateDataKey/Encrypt calls). Who owns KMS rotation policy? Ops vs Infra?
3) Service accounts / secrets: We use Vault for internal secrets; some legacy services still in AWS Parameter Store. Need list of services and migration plan.
4) Access reviews: Frequency? We should propose quarterly access review for prod clusters and monthly for admin role rosters.
5) Incident response: do we have a consolidated incident playbook tailored for SOC2 auditors? We have SRE runbooks scattered. Consolidate.

Control mapping (very rough) -> map common SOC2 CC categories to Redwood artifacts: (intentional shorthand)
- CC6: Logical & physical access controls -> SSO (Okta) + SCIM provisioning + role definitions in IAM + VPN/ bastion logs
  Evidence: Okta org config export, SCIM provisioning logs, IAM policies, last access review spreadsheet (TODO)
- CC7: System operations (change mgmt) -> PR review policy + CI/CD runbooks + deployment approvals (codeowners)
  Evidence: GitHub protected branch settings, merged PRs with approvals, release notes for last 6 months
- CC8: Risk mitigation & incident mgmt -> incident response plan, postmortem template, incident timeline examples
  Evidence: 2 recent postmortems redacted, incident inbox logs, pager duty rota
- CC10: Data backups & recovery -> backup policy, restore test report
  Evidence: Backup job configuration, last successful restore test (date + summary)
- CC12: Encryption & key mgmt -> KMS usage, key rotation policy
  Evidence: CloudTrail KMS logs, KMS rotation config

Evidence backlog (high priority items):
- KMS/Crypto usage log export covering last 12 months (owner: Infra, due: 2024-11-08)
- Okta org export + SCIM provisioning activity (owner: SSO team - Jordan, due: 2024-10-25)
- Consolidated list of secrets stores and owners (Vault vs Parameter Store) (owner: DevOps - Maya, due: 2024-10-30)
- Access review snapshot for prod clusters (owner: Platform Eng, due: 2024-11-05)
- CI/CD policy doc + evidence of enforcement (branch protection screenshots) (owner: Release Eng - Ethan, due: 2024-10-22)

Immediate action items (my todos):
- Draft "evidence index" template in Confluence (table: control id | artifact | location | owner | retention) - extract from this doc and link to JIRA tickets.
- Schedule 1:1 with Jordan to confirm Okta exports and request automated export schedule for auditors.
- Ping infra for KMS logs and request CloudTrail query (need start/end + sample event ids).
- Put together redacted postmortem for auditor consumption (remove sensitive PII/customer data).

Notes for auditor interviews (prep):
- Keep explanations high-level + point to artifacts. Don't go deep into infra IPs.
- For change mgmt, show 2 examples of release to prod with approvals + rollback steps.
- For encryption, auditors often want both config + logs showing usage. Have both.

Risks & mitigations (brainstorm):
- Risk: Legacy secrets in Parameter Store -> mitigation: migration plan + compensating control (short TTL + rotation).
- Risk: Incomplete access review history -> mitigation: run retroactive review and document exceptions.
- Risk: Disparate incident docs -> mitigation: consolidate into single IR playbook and run tabletop exercise.

Meetings / collaborators to loop in:
- SSO team (Jordan) - Okta/SCIM evidence
- Infra (Maya) - KMS, CloudTrail, backups
- Release Eng (Ethan) - CI/CD and approvals
- Legal/Privacy - redaction guidance for postmortems

Random scratch notes (leave here so I remember):
- Might be helpful to pull last 6 months of support tickets referencing data exfil or access issues -> show how we triage. (ops-support JIRA filter?)
- Check whether Dedicated customers have additional contractual controls that need to be in-scope (some may insist on different evidence)
- Consider running a mock audit checklist internally before auditor arrival (scorecard).

Next sync (tentative): weekly touchpoint Thursdays 11am starting 2024-10-24. Agenda: evidence backlog review, blockers, outstanding decisions.

—— END OF SCRATCHPAD — keep informal.
